problemSigns.sign: Door sticks or binds at the same spot every time
problemSigns.detail: This often indicates a bent track section or a roller catching on an obstruction.

problemSigns.sign: Visible bend or dent in the track
problemSigns.detail: Physical damage to the metal track itself prevents smooth roller movement.

problemSigns.sign: Rollers popping out of the track
problemSigns.detail: A misaligned or damaged track causes rollers to disengage, stopping door operation.

problemSigns.sign: Gap between track and door frame
problemSigns.detail: Loose or broken track brackets can cause the track to pull away, affecting door alignment.
